**The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge**  
**Guest Primer: Matt West, Spartan Elite Men’s Health & Med Spa**

Hi Matt,  

I am really looking forward to having you on The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge. This primer is simply a guide so you feel relaxed, prepared, and excited. Nothing is scripted. Our conversation will be casual, story driven, and focused on your expertise and values.  

---

## Quick Snapshot

**Guest:** Matt West, FNP  
**Clinic:** Spartan Elite Men’s Health & Med Spa  
**Location:** Brentwood / Franklin area, Tennessee  

**What you do:**

- Medical disability examiner for veterans under government contract  
- Founder of Spartan Elite, a men’s health clinic built around ethical testosterone replacement, fertility protection, and long term wellness  
- Newly expanded into med spa services with Apex RF for ED, Morpheus8, and Tone  
- Leading a growing team of 1099 estheticians and adding injectables with a monthly Botox day  

---

## Our Audience

Listeners are:

- Med spa owners, injectors, wellness leaders, and practice managers  
- Physicians, NPs, PAs, and RNs who care about ethics and outcomes  
- Entrepreneurs in aesthetics, hormone therapy, and regenerative wellness

They love hearing real stories of growth, lessons learned, and practical takeaways they can apply in their own practices.

---

## Episode Angle

Working ideas:

- **“Ethical Men’s Health, Veterans, and Building Spartan Elite”**  
- **“From Cardiology to TRT and Apex RF: How Matt West Built a Sustainable Men’s Health Practice”**

We will highlight:

- Your transition from cardiology into men’s hormone health  
- How serving veterans has shaped your ethics and practice philosophy  
- Spartan Elite’s membership model and fertility protection focus  
- Why you invested in Apex RF, Morpheus8, and Tone and how that fits into a med spa growth strategy  
- The realities of marketing, Google versus Meta, and local collaborations  

---

## Conversation Flow and Sample Questions

### 1. Your Story and Background

- Can you share a little of your path from cardiology at St. Thomas to launching Spartan Elite  
- What drew you specifically to men’s health and hormone optimization  
- How did your own experience with low testosterone and that first men’s health course change your perspective as a clinician  

### 2. Serving Veterans and Balancing Two Missions

- You still do medical disability exams for veterans several days a week. How did that work begin  
- What have veterans taught you about medicine, paperwork, and patience  
- How do you mentally and practically balance a very demanding government contract with building a private clinic  
- Long term, what is your dream balance between veteran work and Spartan Elite  

### 3. Building Spartan Elite: Model, Ethics, and Growth

- Walk us through the Spartan Elite TRT membership model and why you structured it that way  
  - Initial visit and labs  
  - All inclusive monthly membership  
- You have been very intentional about fertility protection with HCG. Why is that such a non negotiable for you  
- How do you talk to younger men about fertility, especially when cost is a concern  
- What are some ethical lines you see in this space that you refuse to cross  

### 4. Apex RF, ED Treatments, and the Med Spa Side

- Tell us the story of discovering Apex RF and why you believed in the technology  
- What made you comfortable investing in such a large device and becoming a luminary site  
- For men and their partners who have never heard of Apex, how do you explain:  
  - What the treatment is  
  - Why it is different than shockwave  
  - What results you are seeing in real life  
- You also added Morpheus8 and Tone. How are your estheticians using those services, and what has demand been like  

### 5. Team, Compensation, and Keeping Good People

- You put a lot of thought into how you compensate your 1099 estheticians. What matters most to you when you set up pay and commission  
- Why do you think so many med spas struggle with turnover and how are you trying to do it differently  
- What have you learned from having Amy in your corner and giving her multiple roles  

### 6. Marketing, Referrals, and Local Partnerships

- What has worked best so far for bringing in new TRT members  
- Where have you been disappointed with paid marketing, especially around Apex  
- How do you view the mix of Google, Meta, and local referral partnerships going forward  
- You have a simple, clear website that converts well. What did you change that made the difference  
- Talk about your member referral structure and why you see that as part of your marketing budget  

### 7. Vision and Next Steps for Spartan Elite

- In the next 6 to 12 months, what does success look like  
  - TRT membership numbers  
  - Apex and Morpheus utilization  
  - Med spa expansion  
- At what point would you bring in another provider and what qualities would you look for  
- What do you hope Spartan Elite is known for in your community five years from now  

### 8. Takeaways for Other Owners and Clinicians

- For someone thinking about starting a TRT or mens health clinic, what is one thing you wish you had known at the beginning  
- What would you say to providers who are nervous about treating ED or talking openly about sexual health  
- Any encouragement for owners who want to grow but still keep their integrity and patient relationships at the center  

---

## Logistics and Recording Details

- **Recording date:** Friday, December 5  
- **Time:** 10:00 am Central  
- **Platform:** Riverside FM  
  - You will receive a calendar invite with the Riverside link  
  - No software download required, you just click the link  
- **Length:** I block 60 minutes, with about 30 to 40 minutes of actual content  
- **Format:** Video and audio recording, fully edited  
  - If you say anything you want removed, just tell me and we will cut it  
  - If Wi Fi glitches, we pause and pick right back up  

Recording from your office with your Spartan Elite logo and clinic background will be perfect.

---

## Promo Assets I Will Ask From You

If you have them handy, these are helpful:

- High resolution headshot  
- Spartan Elite logo  
- Website link and social media handles  
- A short 3 to 5 sentence bio that you like for marketing  
- Any specific offers or calls to action you want listeners to hear  
  - Example: free consultation for podcast listeners, specific landing page, or referral mention  

---

## How We Will Use the Episode

- Full episode on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and other platforms  
- Short clips for social media and local promotion  
- We can highlight the episode in my marketing channels that reach med spa owners, wellness leaders, and potential referral partners

---

If there is anything you do not want to talk about, or anything you absolutely want to make sure we cover, just reply to this email and let me know.  

Excited to share your story and shine a spotlight on Spartan Elite.
